failure_summary.description: Calls were routed to a neighboring endpoint, an explicit action was omitted, or calls were added for unrelated outcomes.
Arguments or parameter handling diverged from the request or schema, including altered search text, incorrect bounds or buckets, and an unrequested blank value.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already directly addresses exact endpoint matching, outcome coverage, avoiding unrelated calls, preserving constraints, following schema buckets, and not inventing filler values. These failures mainly reflect non-application of those rules; some apparent mismatches also conflict with the supplied schema or expected value representation, so adding a general rule would risk duplicating or contradicting current guidance.
